leaders.name: Jacob DeWitte
leaders.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
leaders.background: Co-founded Legacy Oklo in July 2013 and served as its CEO and a board member until the May 2024 business combination with AltC Acquisition Corp, becoming CEO and a director of the public Oklo Inc.; added Chairman of the Board in April 2025. Holds a Ph.D. and S.M. in Nuclear Engineering from MIT (studied nuclear engineering 2004-2014); prior internships at Sandia National Laboratories, Urenco Limited, GE, and the U.S. Naval Nuclear Laboratory.
leaders.why_they_matter: Founder-CEO who has led Oklo continuously since 2013, now steering its public-company commercialization push (Aurora powerhouse, hyperscaler deals, DOE relationships).

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — DEF 14A Proxy Statement (2026 Annual Meeting, filed April 2026)
sources.quote: Mr. DeWitte co-founded Legacy Oklo and served as its Chief Executive Officer and a member of the board of directors of Legacy Oklo from its inception in July 2013 until May 2024.

leaders.name: Caroline DeWitte (formerly Caroline Cochran)
leaders.title: Chief Operating Officer and Director
leaders.background: Co-founded Legacy Oklo in July 2013 under the name Caroline Cochran and served as its COO and a board member until the May 2024 business combination, becoming COO and a director of the public Oklo Inc. Studied nuclear engineering at MIT (2007-2010); served on the DOE Nuclear Energy Advisory Committee (2018-2019). Married to co-founder and CEO Jacob DeWitte.
leaders.why_they_matter: Co-founder and operations lead; SEC filings now list her under her married name, DeWitte, which is why later filings and press can look like two different people.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — DEF 14A Proxy Statement (2026 Annual Meeting, filed April 2026)
sources.quote: Ms. DeWitte co-founded Legacy Oklo and served as its Chief Operating Officer and a member of the board of directors of Legacy Oklo from its inception in July 2013 until May 2024.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — DEF 14A Proxy Statement, Delinquent Section 16(a) Reports
sources.quote: Caroline DeWitte and Jacob DeWitte are married to each other.

leaders.name: R. Craig Bealmear
leaders.title: Chief Financial Officer
leaders.background: CFO of Legacy Oklo from August 2023, continuing as CFO of the public Oklo Inc. since May 2024. Previously CFO of Renewable Energy Group (acquired by Chevron, June 2022) from April 2021-December 2022; 28-year career at BP plc including Chief Financial Officer - North America Downstream (2015-2020) and Deputy CFO, Refining and Marketing Segment (2013-2015).
leaders.why_they_matter: Brings large-cap energy-company financial discipline (BP, Chevron-acquired REG) to a newly public nuclear startup managing capex-heavy powerhouse buildout.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — DEF 14A Proxy Statement (2026 Annual Meeting, filed April 2026)
sources.quote: R. Craig Bealmear has served as the Company's Chief Financial Officer since May 2024. He previously served as Legacy Oklo's Chief Financial Officer from August 2023 until May 2024.

leaders.name: William Goodwin
leaders.title: Chief Legal and Strategy Officer
leaders.background: Joined Oklo as Chief Legal and Strategy Officer in August 2024. Previously held senior leadership roles at Joby Aviation including special projects and strategy, and worked as Deputy General Counsel supporting Joby's government affairs, Department of Defense initiatives, and regulatory strategy.
leaders.why_they_matter: Brings a playbook from Joby Aviation's advanced-manufacturing/eVTOL certification fight to Oklo's own novel-reactor licensing and government-contracting strategy.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — DEF 14A Proxy Statement (2026 Annual Meeting, filed April 2026)
sources.quote: William Goodwin has served as the Company's Chief Legal and Strategy Officer since August 2024. Prior to joining the Company, Mr. Goodwin held senior leadership roles at Joby Aviation, including special projects and strategy.

leaders.name: Alexandra Renner
leaders.title: Chief Product Officer
leaders.background: Has served as Chief Product Officer since May 2024, after Senior Director of Product (2021-2024), Director of Licensing (2018-2022), and Engineer (2016-2018) roles at Oklo. Before Oklo, worked at the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (2013-2016) as a Reactor Engineer, Project Manager, and Reactor Inspector, including on the Watts Bar Unit 2 startup. Holds a B.S. in Nuclear Engineering from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.
leaders.why_they_matter: A former NRC reactor inspector now owns Oklo's product and licensing strategy, a direct pipeline from regulator to regulated.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — Form 8-K, Item 5.02 (filed July 28, 2026)
sources.quote: Prior to joining the Company, she served in various positions at the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission from 2013 to 2016, including Reactor Engineer, Project Manager, and Reactor Inspector.

leaders.name: John Hanson
leaders.title: Chief of Staff
leaders.background: Chief of Staff since May 2024; joined Oklo in 2015 and held Senior Director of Special Projects (2022-2024), Director of Policies and Procedures (2019-2022), and Reactor Engineer roles. Previously a DOE Office of Science Graduate Research Fellow at MIT researching nuclear materials and corrosion science. Holds a Ph.D. in Nuclear Science and Engineering from MIT and B.S. degrees in Mechanical Engineering and Economics from Ohio State.
leaders.why_they_matter: An 11-year Oklo veteran (since 2015, pre-dating most of the executive team) now centralizing cross-functional execution as the company scales past its 2024 public listing.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — Form 8-K, Item 5.02 (filed July 28, 2026)
sources.quote: John Hanson, 39, has served as Chief of Staff of the Company since May 2024. He has held several leadership and technical roles at the Company since joining in 2015

leaders.name: Vivek Narayanadas
leaders.title: General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
leaders.background: General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since October 2025, after serving as Head of Legal at Oklo from February 2025. Previously Deputy General Counsel at Maven Clinic (2023-2025), General Counsel and Corporate Secretary at MetaMap (2021-2023), and senior legal roles at Shopify and The Rubicon Project; began his career as a litigator in IP, securities, and class-action law. J.D. from Columbia Law School; B.A. in History and Economics from UC Berkeley.
leaders.why_they_matter: Adds hyperscaler-adjacent (Shopify) and high-growth-startup legal experience as Oklo negotiates data-center power deals.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — Form 8-K, Item 5.02 (filed July 28, 2026)
sources.quote: Vivek Narayanadas, 42, has served as General Counsel and Corporate Secretary of the Company since October 2025. He served as Head of Legal at the Company from February 2025 to October 2025.

leaders.name: Erik Lassen
leaders.title: Senior Vice President of Engineering
leaders.background: SVP of Engineering since April 2026, after Senior Director, Manufacturing Center of Excellence (January-April 2026). Held engineering/manufacturing leadership roles at Joby Aviation (2019-2026), most recently Aircraft Final Assembly and Integration Lead; founded and was CTO of Monolith Aeroworks (2011-2019); earlier engineering roles at Virgin Galactic and Scaled Composites. B.S. in Manufacturing Engineering, Brigham Young University.
leaders.why_they_matter: An aerospace serial-production hire (Joby, Scaled Composites, Virgin Galactic) leading engineering just as Oklo pushes toward factory-built, repeatable Aurora powerhouses.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — Form 8-K, Item 5.02 (filed July 28, 2026)
sources.quote: Prior to joining the Company, he held various engineering and manufacturing leadership roles at Joby Aviation, Inc. from 2019 to 2026, most recently serving as Aircraft Final Assembly and Integration Lead.

leaders.name: Michael Dixon
leaders.title: Vice President of Accounting and Controller (Principal Accounting Officer)
leaders.background: VP of Accounting and Controller, and Principal Accounting Officer, since May 2026. Previously at National Grid USA (2020-2026), most recently VP, US/New York Controller and FP&A (2024-2026), responsible for SOX certifications and financial statements of National Grid's North America and New York regulated-utility subsidiaries. Before that, at PricewaterhouseCoopers (2006-2020). Chartered Accountant (Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales); B.S. in Mathematics, University of Edinburgh.
leaders.why_they_matter: Regulated-utility accounting/SOX background signals Oklo building out public-company financial controls as it scales.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — Form 8-K, Item 5.02 (filed July 28, 2026)
sources.quote: Michael Dixon, 42, has served as Vice President of Accounting and Controller of the Company since May 2026. Mr. Dixon will serve as the Company's Principal Accounting Officer.

leaders.name: Daniel B. Poneman
leaders.title: Director
leaders.background: Board member since March 2025. President and CEO of Poneman Strategies LLC since 2024. President and CEO of Centrus Energy Corp. (2015-2023), where he led the launch of the first U.S.-technology-enabled domestic uranium enrichment production since 1954. Deputy Secretary of Energy at the U.S. DOE (2009-2014). J.D. and B.A. from Harvard; MLitt in Politics from Oxford.
leaders.why_they_matter: A director who literally ran the country's newest HALEU/enrichment supplier (Centrus) and ran DOE nuclear policy sits on Oklo's board while fuel sourcing is a top commercial risk.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — DEF 14A Proxy Statement (2026 Annual Meeting, filed April 2026)
sources.quote: Mr. Poneman served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Centrus Energy Corp., where he was responsible for launching the first U.S.-technology enabled domestic uranium enrichment production since 1954.
